import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from stress import build
rng = random.Random(13579)
cases=[]; tot=0
while len(cases)<2 and tot<1024:
    c = build(rng, min(512, 1024-tot), 256, 32, 32, 1, 1, True)
    if not c['windows']: continue
    cases.append(c); tot += len(c['windows'])
req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('cases',len(cases),'windows',tot,'in bytes',len(raw))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/vendor'})
el=time.time()-t0
print('exit',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%el,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',len(p.stderr))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
for c,res in zip(cases,r['results']):
    print(' ratio',res['ratio'],'served',sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0),'arcs',len(res['flow']),'cut',len(res['cut']) if res['cut'] else None)
"
